title: Smart Procurement ERP Logging System
summary: Turns bills, receipts, and invoices into procurement records with confidence-based review.
boundary: Independent prototype. ERP integration tested against Odoo references.
problem: Procurement documents require repetitive reading and manual ERP data entry.
contribution: Built document ingestion, multimodal extraction, backend workflows, and ERP adapters.

workflow.title: Receive documents
workflow.detail: Upload APIs, email inbox watchers and external payloads.

workflow.title: Apply ingestion controls
workflow.detail: Hash deduplication, antivirus scanning and quarantine.

workflow.title: Extract document structure
workflow.detail: PaddleOCR and an 8-bit quantized 8B vision-language model.

workflow.title: Evaluate and review
workflow.detail: Deterministic fallback filters, confidence scoring and manual review gates.

workflow.title: Integrate with an ERP
workflow.detail: A ProcurementERP port and adapters; tested against Odoo references.

architecture.title: Document intelligence
architecture.detail: PaddleOCR and an 8-bit quantized 8B VLM extract document layouts.

architecture.title: Persistence and retrieval
architecture.detail: PostgreSQL with pgvector and full-text search; MinIO/S3 for documents.

architecture.title: Workflow and integration
architecture.detail: Temporal coordinates processing; ERP adapters sit behind the ProcurementERP port.

decisions.title: Separate extraction from acceptance
decisions.detail: Confidence scoring and deterministic filters route uncertain extractions to human review.

decisions.title: Make the ERP boundary explicit
decisions.detail: ERP adapters isolate target-specific integration logic.

decisions.title: Combine OCR with visual-language extraction
decisions.detail: An explicit OCR and VLM configuration supports reproducible future evaluation.

result: Functional prototype completed, including reference-based ERP integration testing.
evidence: Public code, demo, and performance benchmarks are not yet available.

title: Script Change Management
summary: Maintains automated test scripts as application UI and logic change.
boundary: Employer work under NDA. Client data, code, and internal artifacts are omitted.
problem: Application changes break regression tests, creating recurring investigation and script maintenance.
contribution: Developed synchronous orchestration and backend pipelines using Python and LangChain.

workflow.title: Detect a broken script
workflow.detail: A script breakage triggers the maintenance workflow.

workflow.title: Correlate defect reports
workflow.detail: The Auto Defect Management system supplies confirmed reports as application-change signals.

workflow.title: Orchestrate a repair
workflow.detail: Custom Python and LangChain coordinate the synchronous maintenance workflow.

workflow.title: Update the test code
workflow.detail: The workflow produces script changes intended to address the breakage.

architecture.title: Decision and orchestration layer
architecture.detail: Python and LangChain coordinate synchronous decisions and workflows.

architecture.title: Defect workflow bridge
architecture.detail: Auto Defect Management supplies confirmed change signals.

architecture.title: Tracing and observability
architecture.detail: LangSmith traces LLM calls; OpenTelemetry supports observability.

architecture.title: Development tooling
architecture.detail: GitHub Copilot supports Python and LangChain development.

decisions.title: Connect maintenance to diagnostic context
decisions.detail: Use confirmed defect reports to guide script maintenance.

decisions.title: Keep the execution model explicit
decisions.detail: Keep orchestration synchronous in Python and LangChain.

decisions.title: Trace the orchestration
decisions.detail: Use LangSmith and OpenTelemetry to inspect workflow execution.

result: Internal system in development. My contribution covers backend orchestration and pipelines.
evidence: Production rollout, repair acceptance criteria, and measured results are not published.

title: Auto Defect Management System
role: Developer · Evidence collection, duplicate checks and logging
summary: Collects test failure evidence, checks existing Jira issues, and structures new defect reports.
boundary: Employer work under NDA. Client data, code, and internal artifacts are omitted.
problem: Repeated test failures create manual investigation work and duplicate bug reports.
contribution: Developed evidence collection, duplicate checks, and the healing/logging framework.

workflow.title: Capture an execution failure
workflow.detail: Collect failures from Eggplant automation runs.

workflow.title: Gather evidence
workflow.detail: Collect diagnostic context for the failed execution.

workflow.title: Check existing issues
workflow.detail: Compare against existing Jira tickets before reporting a new issue.

workflow.title: Structure a new report
workflow.detail: Format a clean Jira ticket for a genuinely new issue.

architecture.title: Evidence and duplicate checks
architecture.detail: Collects diagnostics and checks Jira for duplicates. Matching details are confidential.

architecture.title: Jira logging and issue tracking
architecture.detail: Connects test logs with Jira issue tracking.

architecture.title: Script-maintenance bridge
architecture.detail: Links defect reporting to Script Change Management.

decisions.title: Check before reporting
decisions.detail: Check Jira before creating a report to reduce duplicates.

decisions.title: Collect context at the failure boundary
decisions.detail: Collect diagnostics when a test fails to support triage.

decisions.title: Connect reporting to script maintenance
decisions.detail: Feed defect context into the connected script-maintenance workflow.

result: Deployed internally to connect test failures, diagnostic evidence, and Jira reporting.
evidence: Deployment scale and measured business impact are not publicly available.
